remarks: Cliffside Waterfront Masterpiece with Unrivaled Views & Timeless Charm. Perched high above the cliff on an extraordinary 8.5-acre waterfront setting, this majestic estate is a rare offering where historic grandeur meets refined modern living. From the moment you arrive, you are captivated by magnificent architectural details, exquisite moldings, & sweeping water views that grace every room. Step into the grand foyer, where a stunning spiral staircase sets the tone for elegance that unfolds throughout. Rich, brilliant hardwood flooring flows seamlessly across the main level, enhancing the home's warmth & sophistication. Meticulously restored & modernized between 2013 and 2015 keeping the grandeur of a 1900 estate but with today's modern conveniences. The home features five spacious BR & 3.5 beautifully appointed baths. Designed for both everyday living & elevated entertaining, the chef's kitchen is a true showpiece-complete with high-end appliances, custom finishes, and a butler's pantry for effortless hosting. A convenient first-floor laundry adds to the home's functionality. The elegant dining room, flanked by rich mahogany walls, creates a dramatic & intimate setting for gatherings, while the impressive fireplace completes the scene. Just beyond, the inviting family room showcases an impressive fireplace-hand painted by a nationally recognized artist-serves as a one of a kind focal point, blending artistry with timeless design and comfort. Step outside to your private retreat, while a built-in heated pool invites relaxation & entertaining against a backdrop of breathtaking waterfront views. A tastefully designed fence lines the bluff's edge providing safety without compromising the views. Enjoy unforgettable sunsets from your elevated vantage point, with the added wonder of frequent visits from the soaring resident eagles. A circular driveway offers ample parking & a grand approach, while the updated front carriage house provides additional space for guests, extended living, or potential income opportunities. A legacy waterfront estate defined by beauty, privacy & unforgettable natural surroundings. Welcome to "The Lady of The Lake"
